exposure_note: The task brief identified the two works and their composer/arranger distinction, and prior exposure is possible. I answered from the candidate questions and independently opened institutional sources before seeing the current writer drafts or any private key.

answers.reason: Wise Music Classical lists Prokofiev as composer and text writer of the 1936 work for narrator and orchestra and states its purpose of introducing children to orchestral instruments. LA Phil independently identifies Prokofiev and the instrument/character design.

The Library of Congress identifies Gershwin as composer and pianist and Grofé as scorer of the 1924 Palais Royal Orchestra version. It identifies Aeolian Hall and the 12 February 1924 premiere date. The distinction excludes Grofé as composer under this wording.
